name: iris-compose-media
title_zh: 一条流水线串起图像、语音、视频的编排器
tagline_zh: 别再手动传文件了。图片生成完自动送审、视频摘要直接变旁白、音频配图一步到位——它帮你把 Iris 工具按目标接好。
tagline_en: Stop hand-carrying files. Auto-chain Iris tools: generate→review, video→narration, audio+image→video.
desc_en: Compose two or more dsh-iris tools into goal-driven image, video, speech, transcription, and multimodal workflows. Use when a request requires analyzing supplied media and creating a derivative, generating then reviewing an image, turning a video summary into narration, preparing image and audio inputs for video, or coordinating asynchronous Iris tasks. Do not use for a single direct media operati
why_zh: 不是工具集合，是编排层。它懂“先产出再检查”的顺序，把中间产物自动喂给下一步。
why_en: It's an orchestrator, not a toolbox. Knows the generate-then-review order, auto-feeds intermediates downstream — no glue code.
limit_zh: 只编排 dsh-iris 自家工具，跨系统或第三方 API 不碰；单步媒体操作（如只转码）别用它，杀鸡用牛刀。
limit_en: Only chains dsh-iris tools; no external APIs. Overkill for single media ops. Requires configured Iris async environment.
title_en: An orchestrator that chains image, audio & video tools
